verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio defines agent teams as declarative JSON specifications and can export teams as runnable Python code. The AgentChat framework documents serializing and deserializing components and logging traces and internal messages. Together these show agent and team configurations can be taken out in open, portable formats, but there is no evidence of a complete export of all user data. Missing for 10: documented export of conversation/session history and memory stores, an explicit full-data export or migration path off the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
